title: Classical Music for Sufferers of ADHD — draft medley
notes: All timestamps are seconds into the SOURCE FILE named in 'file'. Items marked verified:false are estimates for mid-piece entries — run --audit and nudge. Items that start at 0 assume a per-movement source file (see README).

items.piece: R. Strauss - Also sprach Zarathustra, Einleitung (bars 1-21)
items.note: Opening of the piece. Cut on the held C major organ chord.

items.piece: Beethoven - Symphony 5/i (bars 1-24)
items.note: One beat of black after Zarathustra, then the motto.

items.piece: Mozart - Le nozze di Figaro Overture (bars 1-24)
items.note: Snap cut. Sotto voce scurry, tutti detonates ~b.12.

items.piece: Mozart - Symphony 40/i (bars 1-20)
items.note: Major-to-minor Mozart double.

items.piece: Vivaldi - Spring/i opening tutti (bars 1-7)
items.note: Sun-break only.

items.piece: Vivaldi - Summer/iii Presto, opening storm
items.note: Hard cut: the weather turns. Cut before the solo episode.

items.piece: Offenbach - Galop infernal (Can-Can), two 16-bar strains
items.note: Assumes a standalone Galop file. If using the full Orpheus overture, find the galop (~7-8 min in) and set start.

items.piece: Brahms - Hungarian Dance No. 5 (bars 1-32, Parlow orch.)
items.note: Keep the rit./a tempo gags.

items.piece: Bizet - Carmen Suite 1, Les Toreadors: F major refrain strain
items.note: Movement opens with the corrida allegro; the refrain lands mid-movement. ESTIMATE 0:45 — audit.

items.piece: Bizet - Carmen Suite 2, Habanera: vamp + D minor verse (bars 1-22)
items.note: Movement file, starts on the vamp.

items.piece: J. Strauss II - Blue Danube: intro horn accel + Waltz 1A/1B
items.note: ESTIMATE: last bars of intro ~1:05 in most recordings, waltz 1A ~1:20. D minor Habanera resolves into D major waltz. Audit.

items.piece: Grieg - Peer Gynt: Morning Mood (bars 1-10)
items.note: One bar of stillness after the waltz, then solo flute a whole step up.

items.piece: Debussy - Clair de lune (piano bars 1-15; own orchestration for the show)
items.note: Piano recording is fine for the draft; Caplet 1922 orchestration is the PD scoring crib.

items.piece: Holst - Jupiter: Andante maestoso (Thaxted), strain + tutti repeat
items.note: ESTIMATE: Thaxted arrives ~2:55 in most recordings. The emotional summit. Audit.

items.piece: Tchaikovsky - Swan Lake, Scene (bars 1-18): harp/tremolo + oboe theme
items.note: Lights down. Ends the breather in B minor.

items.piece: Grieg - In the Hall of the Mountain King: pizz creep + final prestissimo
items.note: Two splices from one file: bars 1-8 creep, jump-cut to the closing accelerando and stingers.

items.piece: Mussorgsky/Rimsky-Korsakov - Night on Bald Mountain, opening vortex + witches' theme
items.note: Rimsky-Korsakov version ONLY (Stokowski/Fantasia arrangement is protected).

items.piece: Verdi - Requiem, Dies irae (bars 1-20): hammer chords + torrents
items.note: Choral shout folded into trumpets/trombones in the arrangement; any recording works for the draft.

items.piece: Wagner - Ride of the Valkyries (concert version, opening ~35 bars)
items.note: Ostinato from bar 1 through the first full brass statement.

items.piece: Rimsky-Korsakov - Flight of the Bumblebee (bars 1-24)
items.note: The thesis statement.

items.piece: Tchaikovsky - Nutcracker, Trepak (bars 1-32)
items.note: Main strain + repeat, molto vivace.

items.piece: Rossini - William Tell Overture, finale: fanfare pickup + galop x2
items.note: Assumes a standalone Finale file (start 0). If using the full overture, the finale starts ~8:25 — set start and audit.

items.piece: Haydn - Symphony 94/ii (bars 9-16 + the chord)
items.note: Dead cut to pianissimo strings; the surprise chord IS the launch button. ESTIMATE: pp repeat ~0:15, chord ~0:31 — audit carefully, this gag is timing-critical.

items.piece: Elgar - Pomp & Circumstance No. 1: trio tune, D major grandioso statement
items.note: ESTIMATE: the big final trio statement ~4:45 in most recordings. Audit.

bed.piece: Ravel - Bolero: 2-bar snare ostinato, looped as riser
bed.note: Snare sneaks in out of the Haydn chord decay, 4s alone crescendo, rides under Pomp, fades.

items.piece: Beethoven - Symphony 9/iv: full-orchestra Ode statement (from b.164)
items.note: ESTIMATE: tutti D major statement ~4:45 into the finale in most recordings; varies a lot. Audit.

items.piece: Tchaikovsky - 1812 Overture, coda: bells hymn through final fanfares (last ~40 bars)
items.note: Taken from the END of the file, so this works with any recording length. Native E-flat = the built-in semitone lift out of D.

items.piece: Beethoven - Symphony 5/i, bars 1-5: the button
items.note: da-da-da-DUM. Cut to black.
